response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean
